instruction.thesis: GOLD short (FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG) has reached +2.77% P&L against a 5% target and 2.5% stop. The primary thesis signal - gold_hl_funding_ann - has fully normalized from 67.52% at entry to +5.48% now, a 91.9% decline. The crowded-longs thesis has fully played out: funding normalization is complete and spot has declined 2.77% from entry. While the mechanical target is 5%, the funding signal that generated the trade has fully resolved; holding further exposes the position to reversal risk without the original carry tailwind. Closing at ~2.77% gain to lock in profit and free capital. Note: profit_taking is allowed for LLM-reviewed positions per the allowed action surface.

instruction.thesis: GOLD long (FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT) opened at 4536 with thesis that crowded shorts would cover as funding normalized. The primary signal gold_hl_funding_ann has fully normalized from -44.78% to +5.48% (a +50.26pp swing), which is thesis completion - the crowded shorts have covered. However, gold_gc_spot has moved from 4536 to 4532 (-0.09%), meaning the expected spot rally from short-covering has not materialized despite full funding normalization. The thesis has been invalidated: funding normalized but spot did not follow. Closing at -0.09% to avoid holding a position where the signal has resolved without the predicted price action.
